source_name: NBU Statistics section root / Статистика НБУ
why_relevant: Top-level index to all NBU statistical domains (monetary, banking, financial services market, balance of payments). Best snowball node for discovering every downstream dataset page.

source_name: SMIDA — база даних «Учасники ринку» (professional participants: traders, custodians, depositories, asset managers, auditors)
why_relevant: Enumerates licensed professional capital-market participants. Many are bank subsidiaries or bank-affiliated securities traders/custodians; the auditor field also reveals which audit firms sign Ukrainian bank statements — a useful onward pointer for the audit/assurance source cell.

source_name: ФГВФО — Перелік звітності для банків-учасників
why_relevant: Defines what reporting DGF member banks must file to the Fund and in what form. A metadata source: it tells you which datasets on healthy and failing banks exist inside the DGF, which in turn defines what can be requested under access-to-public-information.

source_name: Vernadsky National Library of Ukraine — Ukrainika electronic library / e-resource archiving
why_relevant: The national library states that collecting and archiving online electronic resources is part of the Ukrainika programme — the closest thing to a national web/e-deposit archive for Ukraine. Relevant as a potential institutional custodian of pre-2022 Ukrainian corporate/official publications, though banking-sector coverage is unproven.

source_name: NBU OpenData REST API technical instruction
why_relevant: Full endpoint catalogue and parameter reference for the NBU OpenData REST API — the single document from which every machine-readable NBU disclosure feed can be enumerated.

source_name: Diia Business — довідник підприємця: картки галузевих асоціацій (ЄМА, УАФІК та ін.)
why_relevant: State-run business handbook with structured profile cards for sector associations (ЄМА, фінтех-асоціація and others), each pointing to the association's official site and describing its remit. A government-curated index of which associations exist — a clean way to discover associations this cell has not yet enumerated.

source_name: OpenAid Ukraine (openaid.gov.ua) — aid transparency portal
why_relevant: Ukrainian government portal intended to consolidate all IFI- and donor-supported development projects in Ukraine into one searchable register with Ukrainian project titles and implementing agencies — the local-language crosswalk between an EBRD/IFC project code and how the project is named in Ukrainian official and press usage.

source_name: NBU — List of important payment infrastructure objects (Перелік важливих об'єктів платіжної інфраструктури)
why_relevant: Annually names the systemically important schemes and processors (e.g. PrJSC Ukrainian Processing Center, LLC EJSI DISKI PROTSESSING, LLC TAS LINK). Effectively the NBU's own ranking of who matters in switching/processing.

source_name: NBU disclosure webpage for ownership structures of non-bank financial institutions
why_relevant: Announces a dedicated NBU webpage aggregating ownership-structure disclosures by non-bank financial institutions (incl. payment-sector entities NBU supervises since 2020) — a beneficial-ownership node for the payments half of the run scope.

source_name: ВАФК — Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній: Учасники Асоціації
why_relevant: Membership roster of non-bank financial companies (finance companies, microlenders, payment-adjacent FIs), split into full and associate members. Captures the long tail of licensed financial companies that never surface in bank-focused sources.

source_name: Issuer/acquirer bank PROSTIR product pages (e.g. Universal Bank/monobank, A-Bank, PUMB)
why_relevant: Bank-side PROSTIR pages confirm scheme membership, acceptance enablement and product rollouts earlier than the scheme's own participant list; a practical cross-check on scheme penetration.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА (Українська міжбанківська асоціація членів платіжних систем) — Члени
why_relevant: Single densest enumeration of the Ukrainian payments population: card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), ~40 banks, PSPs/fintechs (NovaPay, Platon, EasyPay, iPay.ua, RozetkaPay, PayForce, Payoneer, monobank, A-Bank), marketplaces (OLX, Prom.ua) and the credit bureau UBKI. Each entry is a logo+link, so it snowballs directly into corporate sites and their IR/press pages.

source_name: Ukrainian cash-handling equipment distributors (Glory/CIMA sorters) — TCS Спецтехніка, Fintex, Eco Trading, IT-Consul, Tech Profit
why_relevant: Cash-handling is the least-disclosed segment of Ukrainian bank capex. Local distributor catalogues for Glory banknote counters/sorters (GFS-120S, GFS-220F, UW-600) and modular cash-processing and recycling systems reveal which cash-handling brands are supplied into Ukrainian banks and cash-in-transit operations, including a visible second-hand/refurbished market that signals constrained budgets.

source_name: УКБС — Український кредитно-банківський союз
why_relevant: Third national banking association (est. 1994 as Kyiv Banking Union, renamed 2005), reported to unite ~92 financial-credit institutions plus representative offices of foreign financial institutions — including smaller regional banks and non-bank lenders that the larger associations may omit.

source_name: ВАКС — Всеукраїнська асоціація кредитних спілок: розділ members
why_relevant: Credit-union membership directory with per-member pages (observed URL pattern /members/<id>/). Credit unions are deposit-taking, card-issuing-adjacent actors and part of the retail financial-services population; also a natural target base for POS/payment infrastructure.

source_name: НАКСУ / Кредитні спілки України (unascu.org.ua)
why_relevant: The second national credit-union association alongside ВАКС; together they enumerate the credit-union population. Needed for completeness because the two associations' rosters only partly overlap.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ) — Члени АУБ
why_relevant: Oldest UA banking association (est. 1990); membership reported at 70–125 institutions including state, commercial and non-bank financial companies. The members page is the pointer index into individual bank sites and their disclosure/IR pages.

source_name: IT Ukraine Association — member directory (banking/fintech software vendors)
why_relevant: Industry-association member directory that enumerates Ukrainian IT companies with profiles and links, including banking/payments vendors such as ProFIX Group. Best used as an actor-map expander: it surfaces vendor names that then get tracked individually for bank-engagement announcements.

source_name: Opendatabot / YouControl — реєстраційні картки асоціацій (ЄДРПОУ)
why_relevant: For every association in this cell there is a state-registry card giving EDRPOU, registration date, legal address, officers and — critically — founders/participants. For ВАФК and ВАКС the registry card actually names member/founder legal entities, providing a verifiable cross-check when an association's own member page is gated or stale.

source_name: GLEIF LEI Issuers (LOU) directory for Ukraine
why_relevant: Identifies which Local Operating Units / registration agents actually issue LEIs to Ukrainian entities — useful for understanding coverage bias in the UA LEI population and for locating secondary LEI lookup services that mirror the data.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox knowledge base
why_relevant: Official Prozorro explainer library — documents how to search tenders, how State Audit Service monitoring works, and which analytics modules exist. Methodological backbone for building a reliable collection routine and for interpreting field semantics.

entity_name: Checkbox / E-Chek and comparable Ukrainian PRRO+POS resellers
source_name: Checkbox / E-Chek and comparable Ukrainian PRRO+POS resellers — terminal catalogues
why_relevant: Ukrainian software-RRO (ПРРО) and terminal resellers publish concrete device catalogues and bank-acquiring partner lists, exposing which terminal hardware brands are actually distributed in Ukraine and which banks each reseller is integrated with. A practical route to the POS hardware supply chain when neither banks nor global OEMs disclose Ukrainian distributors.

entity_name: DoZorro civic monitoring portal and tools directory
source_name: DoZorro civic monitoring portal and tools directory
why_relevant: Transparency International Ukraine's monitoring layer over ProZorro; curates the analytics toolset and publishes investigations that flag suspect banking/IT contracts. Good for discovering additional tools, datasets and named actors.

entity_name: Local Ukrainian audit firms' transparency reports
source_name: Local Ukrainian audit firms' transparency reports (long tail, e.g. ТОВ «СОВА-Аудит»)
why_relevant: Smaller Ukrainian firms also publish Art.37 transparency reports on their own sites; some audit small banks and non-bank payment institutions that the international networks do not cover. Demonstrates the long-tail pattern (self-hosted PDF, no central aggregator).

source_name: Opendatabot API documentation (docs.opendatabot.com)
why_relevant: Technical entry point describing which public registers are machine-readable through Opendatabot (USREOU/ЄДР, tax, court, sanctions), needed to design a repeatable collection pipeline for bank and payment-institution filings.

source_name: SUCHO — Saving Ukrainian Cultural Heritage Online (5,400+ archived Ukrainian sites, ~50TB)
why_relevant: Largest wartime crawl of the .ua web outside the Internet Archive, built with Browsertrix/ArchiveWeb.page from March 2022 and mirrored outside Ukraine. Primarily cultural institutions, so bank IR coverage is likely incidental rather than systematic — but it is the main non-IA repository of Ukrainian WARCs, and its crawl seed lists and methodology are a template for a banking-sector crawl.

source_name: UKR.NET source aggregator — media outlet feeds (e.g. PaySpaceMagazine)
why_relevant: National news aggregator that maintains per-outlet chronological feeds; a cheap discovery layer for finding additional Ukrainian financial outlets and for backfilling an outlet's article history without crawling the outlet itself.

source_name: UNITY-BARS — projects / national projects and products pages (ABS BARS core banking, COPR2, Corplight)
why_relevant: Second major Ukrainian core-banking/digital-banking vendor (founded 1991, Kyiv R&D, patent holder of ABS BARS, internet/mobile banking COPR2 and Corplight, credit and DWH modules). Its 'national projects' page is an explicit customer/reference list that maps state and private institutions to specific banking platforms — a direct pointer to who runs what.

source_name: Wikipedia (en/uk) bank articles as a citation-archive pointer for defunct Ukrainian banks
why_relevant: Articles on failed or legacy Ukrainian banks (Finance and Credit, First Investment Bank, KredoBank, Oschadbank) systematically carry archived-URL citations with capture dates pointing at web.archive.org copies of now-dead bank pages. A cheap, high-yield way to harvest known-good archived URLs for institutions whose domains no longer resolve.

source_name: YouControl Market — catalogue of Ukrainian companies (Каталог компаній України)
why_relevant: Open-facing catalogue layer over YouControl covering ~7m entities; usable to enumerate banks, payment institutions, financial companies and their branches by activity code and region without a full YouControl licence.

source_name: АФІ — Асоціація фінансових інституцій
why_relevant: Self-described 'platform for protecting professional interests of financial-services market participants' (registered 2016, EDRPOU 40964265). Another membership pointer for the non-bank/payments segment; the Facebook page is currently the most reliably reachable presence — the afi.org.ua website was referenced but not confirmed.
